summary: Healthy Choice Wellness Corp. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market equity offering of up to $2,625,000 of Class A common stock under a Controlled Equity Offering Sales Agreement with Cantor Fitzgerald. The ATM is an ordinary capital-raising transaction, not a special situation. Sales may occur on NYSE American at prevailing market prices; the agent earns up to 3.0% commission. No deal terms apply. Routine filing; no strategic event or restructuring.
